development.state: Reviewed Beta 0.1.23 / App213 / Driver204 implementation corresponds to the exact retained signed binaries. The public source tag, executable hashes and distribution identities are recorded in release provenance.

public_release.driver_build_scope: Exact signed, physically tested Driver204 retained unchanged; implementation/config/project input correspondence to the reviewed Beta 0.1.23 public source is verified.

qualification.public_summary: Beta 0.1.23 includes the accepted CLI completed-capture admission correction and FCP reply recovery when interrupt delivery stalls. On the tested Sony MiniDV setup, bounded PLAY/STOP, a 15-second GUI capture and a second short CLI capture finalized and opened in playback, with the app returning ready. Capture continuity remains unresolved; warnings and limits are retained below.
qualification.architecture: App213 and normal CLI arm64; Driver204 arm64e. Intel unsupported.
qualification.hardware_scope: Sony MiniDV deck on the tested setup: bounded App213/Driver204 PLAY/STOP, GUI capture and CLI reentry passed. This does not qualify pristine continuity, endurance or broad compatibility.
qualification.pal_capture: Successful Alpha0.0.77/Driver183 capture:78581PALframes, about52minutes; Alpha0.0.87/Driver188 additional11761PALframes. Saved-data verification passed; operator-stopped, not completed whole-tape PAL coverage.
qualification.dv_playback: Native offline playback/media/seek and archive regressions passed. Historical signed App212 inspector/chooser/playback UI checks retain their original scope. Exact App213 opened both finalized files from the bounded Driver204 capture/STOP/reentry session. Continuous mixed-format displayed-pixel/inspector association and M1 final-package playback remain unqualified.
qualification.full_tape_endurance: Successful Alpha0.0.81/Driver183 NTSC whole-tape workflow:112412frames, about62:30.8media; observed stop, drain, saved-data verification and native reread passed. Boundaries inferred; continuity/terminal partial-data warnings retained. Not a new Driver204 endurance test.
qualification.distribution: Beta 0.1.23/App213/Driver204 and normal CLI are Developer ID signed and notarized. The exact qualified signed App213 and Driver204 were retained unchanged; the normal CLI was built from reviewed public source. Executable, profile and package digests are bound in provenance. Apple notarization, stapling, Gatekeeper and distribution checks passed. All four downloaded release assets match the original candidate. Independent exact-byte review resolved all 24 package and six initial status-document findings; no sensitive information or credentials were found in those package/status bytes. The two exact historical source-fixture identity constants are separately approved by the owner; this narrow approval does not extend to other private information. Raw scanner findings and per-finding evidence remain preserved privately.
qualification.capture: Two short PLAY/STOP monitor cycles, one 15-second GUI capture and one short CLI-initiated capture finalized; both saved files opened in playback and app readiness returned. Nineteen watchdog receive recoveries, one routed command-reply recovery and two startup bus resets were recorded. Each capture reported two CIP discontinuities and one incomplete frame. Zero known dropped packets does not prove continuity. No command timeout, reset storm or post-STOP lockout was observed in this bounded session.
qualification.hot_unload: unqualified; use shutdown/restart-based replacement or removal; successful live extension disable is not a prerequisite for normal capture STOP
qualification.startup: During the bounded physical session, driver start was delayed by approximately two minutes after boot; Sony discovery followed comparatively quickly. Cause remains unknown. No universal startup timing claim is made.
qualification.automation: Normal CLI/MCP source exposes 66 tools. The packaged CLI identifies Beta 0.1.23 / App213 / Driver204. Same-user app socket and session-scoped sandbox grants remain required; hardware tools require separately qualified attended operation.
qualification.iec_metadata: Human-readable camera and supplemental fields, context and validity, raw observations and references are available in Capture/Playback Overview, searchable Metadata and Evidence. Catalog covers256pack allocations/274layouts and216audited geometries. Opaque, absent, reserved, manufacturer-specific and disputed values remain explicit; no claim of complete semantic decoding or IEC certification.
qualification.mixed_archive: Source-bound recording epochs and ordered lossless segmented exports validated offline; unknown regions preserved; mixed-system single-file merge and film/container output reject explicitly; HDV remains separate
qualification.signed_app_ui: Bounded App213 physical qualification confirmed normal readiness, capture STOP/finalization, CLI reentry and playback of the resulting saved files. The complete offline inspector, resizing and repeated file chooser interaction matrix is not newly claimed by this release pass.
qualification.historical_b190_startup: stable final generation before capture; no reset observed during these bounded captures; broader startup/reset coverage remains open
qualification.m1_preview: App189 inspector layout correction and bounded paced offline replay passed on the earlier M1 setup. Physical live-preview retest outstanding. App189 chooser visibility over Screen Sharing unresolved; MacBook Air unavailable for local comparison. Neither result qualifies rebuilt App190/Driver193.
qualification.development: Beta 0.1.23 / App213 / Driver204 accepted source is synchronized in the reviewed public source and canonical private development. Driver204 is the tested signed executable; no new physical test was performed during publication.
qualification.software_validation: 355 Foundation tests across four suites passed. Driver host tests and offline runtime regression checks passed, including the completed-capture CLI admission and delayed FCP reply recovery paths. These checks do not establish sustained physical capture continuity.
qualification.platform_requirements: Apple silicon only. macOS 26 Tahoe or macOS 27 Golden Gate is required. Older macOS versions and Intel Macs are unsupported; later macOS releases are not currently supported or qualified.
qualification.continuity: Unresolved: two CIP discontinuities and one incomplete frame were reported per capture. The known dropped-packet counter reported zero; this is not proof of complete source continuity or loss-free capture.
